entities.name: Order of Leitbur
entities.description: A religious sect of Cleric Knights in Sarpadia on Dominaria, founded by Bethan Leitbur, dedicated to Icatia's defense.

entities.name: Bethan Leitbur
entities.description: Founder of the Order, worshipped by its members; recorded his teachings in The Way.

entities.name: Hand of Justice
entities.description: Avatar of justice worshipped by the Order's members.

entities.name: The Way
entities.description: Bethan's recorded teachings, used as a codex by the Order.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: Order fundamentally opposed to the Order of Leitbur.

entities.name: Tourach
entities.description: Figure whose influence the Order guards its transcripts against.

entities.name: Icatia
entities.description: Nation in Sarpadia the Order helped defend; it fell.

entities.name: Farrelite Cult
entities.description: Cult with beliefs similar to Leitbur's but fanatical, which swayed many members of the Order.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Incited the Orc-Goblin army into attacking Montford.

entities.name: Orc-Goblin army
entities.description: Army whose suicidal, lightning-fast attacks brought down Icatia.

entities.name: Montford
entities.description: Place attacked by the Orc-Goblin army.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria where the Order existed.

events.summary: Internal strife weakens the Order as many members are swayed into the Farrelite Cult.
events.quote: Internal strife in Icatia weakened the Order as many members were swayed into the Farrelite Cult

events.summary: Tevesh Szat incites the Orc-Goblin army to attack Montford, causing the fall of Icatia.
events.quote: the fall of a splintered Icatia is caused by Tevesh Szat inciting the Orc - Goblin army into attacking Montford

events.summary: The Order, trained against Ebon Hand tactics, is unprepared for the Goblins; the Icatian army and Order defend strongly but Icatia falls.
events.quote: The Icatian army and the Order would put up a strong defense, but all of Icatia would fall.
